claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0007 omits the governing exception in paragraph (a)(3)(iii)(B) ('Except as provided in paragraph (a)(3)(iii)(B)( 4 ) of this action') from both its summary and scope_text, despite including it in raw scope quotes. Because raw quotation alone does not credit an omitted condition or exception, the claim states an overbroad requirement on all seats manufactured between those dates. Modality ('must') is correctly captured, and no explicit actor, action, or object fields are defined in the passive source rule.

unit_judgments.rationale: Claim C0007 partially covers unit U0000. While it captures the core labeling rule and standard manufacturing dates (January 1, 1981, to February 25, 1985), it omits the governing exception from paragraph (a)(3)(iii)(B) ('Except as provided in paragraph (a)(3)(iii)(B)( 4 ) of this action') from its operative meaning and scope.
